description: Capture clean PNG screenshots of public X posts and profiles. No login or cookies required.

bothThemes.description: When on, every target is captured twice: once in dark and once in light. Files and rows are unique per theme (one screenshot row per theme) and the run summary reports both themes. Overrides the Theme selection.
bothThemes.title: Both themes

captureMode.description: What to capture. Post links produce a single post card or a thread image; profile modes apply to profile links (and convert post links to the author profile).
captureMode.title: Capture mode

deviceScaleFactor.description: Render the page at a higher pixel density for sharper screenshots. 2x doubles and 3x triples the pixel dimensions.
deviceScaleFactor.title: Pixel density

format.description: File format of the saved screenshot. JPEG and WEBP support the quality setting; PNG is lossless.
format.title: Image format

fullPage.description: When on, the whole page is captured instead of just the post card or the visible profile header.
fullPage.title: Full-page capture

hideReplies.description: Hide reply posts so screenshots stay focused on original posts.
hideReplies.title: Hide replies

includeEvidence.description: Save a gzipped DOM snapshot and a JSON manifest to the key-value store for every capture, and add screenshotSha256, domSnapshotSha256, evidenceKey and manifestKey to each row. Failures still get a manifest with the typed failure state.
includeEvidence.title: Include evidence pack

includeMetadata.description: Add details to each row: post id, post URL, author handle, text snippet and the author's follower, following and post counts for posts; username, display name, follower, following and post counts for profiles. Counts are only added when X shows them.
includeMetadata.title: Include post/profile details

maxThreadHeight.description: Maximum thread column height in CSS pixels; the saved image is DPR times taller. The value is clamped so the image cannot exceed the 32,767 px screenshot ceiling (10,922 CSS px at 3x). Taller threads are clipped and the row reports threadComplete=false with the truncation reason.
maxThreadHeight.sectionDescription: Optional settings for large or repeated runs.
maxThreadHeight.title: Max thread height (px)

postUrls.description: Posts to capture as clean post cards. Paste x.com or twitter.com links, bare numeric post IDs, profile links or bare usernames. Any input works in every list.
postUrls.title: X post links, IDs or usernames

profileUrls.description: Optional. Profiles to capture. Paste profile links, bare usernames, post links or post IDs and the actor routes them to the right capture. Use capture mode to choose the header only or the loaded profile preview.
profileUrls.title: X profile links or usernames

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use a proxy if you plan large runs or see frequent rate limits.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

quality.description: Quality for JPEG and WEBP output (1-100). Ignored for PNG.
quality.title: Image quality

tweetUrls.description: Alias of X post links. Accepts tweet links, bare tweet IDs, profile links and bare usernames.
tweetUrls.title: Tweet links (alias)

viewportHeight.description: Browser height used for the capture.
viewportHeight.title: Viewport height (pixels)

viewportWidth.description: Browser width used for the capture. Higher values fit more of the page.
viewportWidth.title: Viewport width (pixels)

title: Twitter (X) Screenshot Generator
